constraints.ocl:
context Payment
inv: self.isProcessed implies self.loan <> null

context Payment
inv: self.isProcessed implies self.fine <> null

context Payment
inv: (self.loan.fine = self.fine) and (self.timestamp <> '' and self.timestamp.size() > 0)

context Address
inv: (self.member <> null) and (self.branch <> null)

context Copy
inv: (self.branch.library.maxLoanDays >= 2) and (self.barcode <> '' and self.barcode.size() > 0)

context Branch
inv: (self.address.branch.code <> '') and (self.name.size() >= 8 implies self.name.substring(1, 8) = 'AB')

context Fine
inv: self.amount >= 51 and self.amount <= 58

context Fine
inv: self.payments->size() >= 1 and self.payments->size() <= 1

context Book
inv: (self.pages.abs() <= 6) and (self.authors->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null)

context Book
inv: (self.publishYear mod 2 = 0) and (self.authors->collect(x | x.books)->size() >= 2)

context Author
inv: self.books->size() >= 3 and self.books->size() <= 3

context Reservation
inv: self.requestDate <> null implies self.expiryDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.returnDate <> null and self.startDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.dueDate <> null implies self.returnDate <> null

context Reservation
inv: self.expiryDate <> null implies self.requestDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.startDate <> null implies self.dueDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.startDate <> null and self.dueDate <> null and self.returnDate <> null

context Category
inv: (self.books->any(x | x.publishYear < 100) <> null) and (self.books->size() <= 3)
